title: Oversize Bay Surcharge for Heavy-Duty Models and Vans — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
Oversize vehicles held on the storage lot under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract carry a daily oversize surcharge on a storage charge through a statement date. It follows the vehicle description printed on the contract and the vehicle's age.

**Age.** The age is the whole years from January 1 of the model year to the statement date, a year counted only once it is complete.

| Vehicle description and age | Bay | Daily oversize surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| A heavy-duty model (HD) or a van, no more than 5 years old (the newer-model years) | secure oversize bay | $10.00 a day, the newer-model surcharge |
| A heavy-duty model (HD) or a van, more than 5 years old | open oversize bay | $6.00 a day, the older-model surcharge |
| Any other vehicle | — | none |

### Age boundaries (hypothetical)

| Model year | Statement date | Age | Surcharge for an HD model or a van |
|---|---|---|---|
| Five years before the statement year | any day of the statement year | 5 | $10.00 |
| Six years before the statement year | 1 January of the statement year | 6 | $6.00 |
| Six years before the statement year | 31 December of the statement year | 6 | $6.00 |

On 1 January the year just ended is complete and counts. A sedan or a pickup whose description names neither a heavy-duty model nor a van carries no surcharge at any age.
